question: ________ is a change of position.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Motion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Motion is the process of moving or being moved, as well as a change in the position of an item.**
 
• The term "**body in motion**" refers to when a body's location in relation to its **environment changes.**
 
• **Motion** is mathematically characterised in terms of **displacement, distance, velocity, acceleration, and speed** as well as the observer's frame of reference and the measurement of the change in the body's position with respect to that frame as time passes.
 
• **Kinematics** is the field of physics that studies forces and their effects on motion, while **dynamics** studies the motion of objects without regard to their source.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Speed**

 
 
• The distance travelled in relation to the time it took to travel that **distance** is how speed is defined. As **speed** simply has a direction and no **magnitude**, it is a **scalar** **quantity**.
 
 
 
• **Velocity**
 
 
• In **kinematics**, the area of classical mechanics that deals with the **motion** of bodies, **velocity** is a fundamental idea.** A physical vector quantity called velocity **must have both a **magnitude** and a direction in order to be defined.
 
 
 
• **Distance**
 
 
• **Distance** is the scientific term used to describe how far an object has moved. **A scalar quantity, distance.** **The International System of Units defines a metre as the distance unit.**
